title: Words for the Signpost

readiness.reading: building short words from their sounds (older: without letters shown)

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: The old signpost by the bridge blew down, and the visitors keep getting lost! I've made new arms for it.

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Each arm needs its word painted on. Can you make the words? Tap a picture to hear what it says.

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: Up it goes! Now nobody will lose their way.

journal_line: I made the words for the new signpost by the bridge.
